 Order

Dated this the 06th day of January, 2026 The petitioner is the 1st accused in C.P No. 108 of 2022 pending before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Kodungallur, has filed this Crl.M.C seeking a direction to the Judicial First Class Magistrate, Kodungallur, to consider the bail application to be moved by him in the above case on the date of filing itself.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Kodungallur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. The offences alleged against the petitioner are under Sections 341, 323, 324, 506(1), 498(A), 420,
406, 308 r/w 34 of the IPC.

3. According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, he is working abroad and hence he could not appear before the learned Magistrate, which resulted in issuing cohesive steps including a non-bailable warrant against him.
He is ready to surrender before the learned Magistrate without any further delay.
His apprehension is that, in case he surrenders and moves a bail application, the same may not be considered by the learned Magistrate on the date of filing itself.

3. Considering the fact that this is a matrimonial dispute, I am inclined to dispose of this Crl.M.C.
with a direction to the petitioner to surrender before the learned Magistrate within a period of two weeks from today and with a further direction to the learned Magistrate that, in case the petitioner surrenders before the learned Magistrate as above and moves a bail CRL.MC NO. 34 OF 2026 2026:KER:387 application after serving copy to the learned Public Prosecutor in advance, the same shall be considered on the date of filing itself.
Sd/-
